checklistItems.label: Marcus is behind on his follow-up calls and plans to stay late to catch up. Decide with him what to do.
Marcus keeps his calls short so customers don't wait. Agree with him what, if anything, should change on his calls.
Three upset customers are about to hear from Marcus. Agree with him how he handles those calls.

scenarioSummary.now: You manage a small customer support team. Marcus takes calls from customers who have a problem. When he can't fix it on the call, he writes a short note, and the tech team fixes it from that. Later, Marcus calls the customer to check that it worked. Lately his follow-up calls have been late, and the same customers keep calling in again. Marcus asked to talk to you.
scenarioSummary.layers: A late follow-ups: stay late and catch up vs ask what is really happening → B short calls: keep them as they are vs one clear change to the note and why → C upset customers: Marcus handles them alone vs does the calls with Nina next to him.

learnerCopy.description: You manage a small customer support team. Marcus takes calls from customers who have a problem. Lately his follow-up calls have been late, and the same customers keep calling in again. Marcus asked to talk to you. Help him work out what to do.
learnerCopy.characterCard: Friendly and quick. Proud that customers never wait long on his calls. A bit embarrassed that his follow-ups are late.
learnerCopy.entryCardBody: Marcus's follow-up calls have been late, and the same customers keep calling in again. Help him with the late calls, how he handles his calls, and the upset customers.
